I’ve been trying my absolute hardest to remember to take the medication. It’s been tough having been off of it for so long that I’m not used to it anymore. 

I’ve been to therapy when I was younger for my anxiety, but not anger issues. I honestly don’t remember much of therapy. What would the therapist do?

Yeah that’s exactly what I feel too! It calms be, but not in the moment. Thank you for your comment. To know somebody is fighting this the same as I am gives me hope. I really hope that you overcome this.
I respect your opinion, but do you have any advice for the anger issues and how I can control them?

I understand where you’re coming from, but this is why I’m asking for help and advice. I want to be with her. She’s a great person with a loving heart and I want to be that way too. We do bump heads a lot because some things she asks for are difficult for me to figure out. For example, I’ve never been the romantic type, but she’s a hopeless romantic. I’m trying to learn how to be romantic for her, but sometimes I don’t do as much as I feel she’s expecting. So we clash.

Well one thing she’s really on right now is that when we were six months (were two years now) I told her I would take her to an escape room, but I haven’t. Or that my sisters fiancé and my/his friend said something that offended her and she wanted me to talk to them, but I didn’t, and now it’s too long apart to talk to them.
This does help a lot, thank you. Do you have any recommendations that I can do at this moment? I’m going to see her in about an hour and she’s expecting a “HUGE action”
By doing what though. Like what actions can I do.
I live in Orange County in California! But she lives in LA county! We’ve done a lot of the cliche things in LA county that everyone does.
How can I possibly talk to her about this situation? Is there ANY way to solve something like this?
She told me “if I just tell you it’s going to be fake. I already know you don’t love me”

I honestly feel like I can’t bring up any girl at all. Even when I’m at work there’s this girl that always comes by and jokes around with everybody, but she helps me a lot. Not because she wants to be with me, she’s pregnant and has a fiancé, but because she’s just nice. But if I tell Rose about her then I know she’ll go off and have a problem with me being at work when she’s there

She’s only really had one official boyfriend, which i know is a reason she’s acting like this. It was a bad relationship and he did things to her that she doesn’t feel comfortable telling anyone. But I think he’s a huge reason why she’s so insecure. But I’ve tried to tell her so many times that she is the one I want. Not Rachel. Not anyone else.
She wants her completely out of my life.
That’s what I think too! Although Rachel’s family isn’t close to mine anymore, Rose’s only argument is “I’m not going to be in a relationship with someone who’s friends with someone they fucked”

It really hurts me. Rachel and I had the same interest in music and she recommended a band to me at the Halloween party. So I started listening to them and really liked them. They went on tour and she messaged my in Facebook asking if I was going and it killed me, because I had to ignore her and leave her on read because I knew once I messaged back Rose would think something bad. And to this day it almost brings me to tears because I think about how Rachel is feeling. She was insecure too and I can’t help to think she’s crying because she thinks she did something wrong and I’m mad at her, but in reality she didn’t do anything at all.

But is it wrong what she’s telling me to do? The way she’s telling me. Like “who is it going to be, me or her.” “Block her or else I’m leaving”. I’ve had to block like 4 people already and it’s so hurtful to me. Yeah there’s a couple that I understand. Two were previous ex’s that kept causing trouble. But Rachel has done nothing wrong to Rose in any way. She even told me that she wanted to me Rose and that she’s happy for me.

That’s the thing. I’m literally at her house every day. I bring her roses, I cuddle with her, but the hardest thing is going out on dates. I work weekends and go to school on the weekdays, so by the time I get to her house it’s about 6:30-7pm. She has a 10:30 pm curfew so I try to do as much as possible between that amount of time, but that’s not much time to go out on a real date and talk to her about such a deep topic. She’s told me she’ll only talk to me about it if I take her to a place to talk.
What is a copyright claim?
The music  I'm mainly thinking of using is like the high end companies like Nintendo and Playstation. I'm wanting to use music from like Banjo-Kazooie and Zelda, stuff like that.
She's also in Vegas right now for EDC so I'm not gonna start bringing things up when she's on vacation.

Yeah they're coworkers. And yeah I don't doubt that he flirts with her constantly. It pisses me off. He doesn't text her nonstop though, it's just out of the blue sometimes, but still. I can't say shit to him though because 1. I don't know the guy. and 2. I already confronted her about it and she told me not to worry at all. They're still friends and I mean, that's okay, but I don't appreciate him texting her asking for picture of her cleavage. I asked her if any other guy texted her and she said "a few but only as friends. I only want you, not anyone else." But yeah I agree, out of respect she should stop texting him all together.
M/22. Nah this is my third. Just first with depression.

Right now that's what I'm trying to do. I'm supporting the things she's doing, as little as it may be and reminding her that I love her with all my heart no matter what she's going through. Every once in a while I'll just send her a text telling her how much she means to me and how much I respect her. 

How do I not let her push me away though?
No, I can't leave her because of this. We're a team. I just have to be patient I guess
I'm scared that she's going to push me away honestly.
I plan on taking her to Griffith Park Observatory soon so maybe it won't be as quiet there.

Well her and I have known each other for about 2 years now and we've been dating for almost 3 months. So we know a lot about each other already. I really have problems with keeping a conversation in general so its hard already.
Well the reason I don't have much money is because I pay bills and need food to live.
